name: perch
description: Perch is a UniFi-only captive portal SaaS for coffee shops.

scripts.demo:setup: npm run demo:env && npm run demo:db:up && npm run demo:db:wait && npm run demo:reset
scripts.demo:reset: npm run demo:env && sh -c 'set -a; . ./.env.demo.local; set +a; prisma db push --force-reset --accept-data-loss && prisma db seed'
scripts.demo:dev: npm run demo:env && sh -c 'set -a; . ./.env.demo.local; set +a; next dev --webpack'
scripts.demo:worker: npm run demo:env && sh -c 'set -a; . ./.env.demo.local; set +a; tsx scripts/silent-free-worker.ts'
